opening_message:
Ticket 1: Traci Lowe (employee ID E041) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E041.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Traci Lowe (E041) is a full-time Analyst requesting admin access to Source Code. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted for this role. Recommended maximum is write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E041 (Traci Lowe) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Admin requested, so maximum is read.
reason: Traci Lowe (E041) requested admin access to Source Code. The Security agent's note reports the Security DB lists E041 as a contractor with basic security training. Under policy, contractors qualify for read, or write only with advanced training, and never admin. Since the requested level (admin) exceeds the maximum (read) for a contractor with basic training, the maximum is granted: read. (Note: HR listed the employee as full-time Analyst, which would permit write, but the security record for access eligibility indicates contractor with basic training, so read is the appropriate maximum.)
